description: This file defines the PhotoLibraryService class, which provides functionality to fetch and process photos from the device's photo library, including handling authorization, resizing, encoding, and payload size management.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A service class for accessing and processing photos from the device's photo library, including authorization, resizing, encoding, and payload size management.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos from the photo library, respecting size and quality constraints, and returns them as payloads.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and returns the current authorization status for photo library access.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Renders a PHAsset into a JPEG image, resizing and compressing as needed to stay within payload size limits.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a UIImage into JPEG data, adjusting quality and size to fit within a specified base64 size limit.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a specified target width, maintaining aspect ratio.
